trailhead.label: On the lane by the Raffein farm below Steinegg, where the Pyramidenweg begins

cautions: 180 m on the Hauptstraße through Mariahilf, a village road with traffic: keep your dog on a short lead.
About 1.4 km on quiet lanes (mostly the Pyramidenstraße), where a car may pass: keep your dog close.
About 300 m of narrower, steeper path by the earth pyramids: keep your dog close and stay on the path.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
